Question 2
?

Find the specific solution to the differential equation dydx=y2+1 given that y(π2)=1.

a
y=tan⁡(x+π4)
b
y=tan⁡(x+π2)
c
y=cot⁡(x−π4)
d
y=tan⁡(x−π4)
e
y=cot⁡(x+π2)
